exceptions.src/main.s: Address-ordered 68000 translation-unit index; it deliberately contains no game implementation.
exceptions.src/macros/macros.inc: Shared assembler pseudo-instructions; definitions are kept together and emit no bytes.
exceptions.src/memory/constants.inc: Small hardware constant vocabulary; padding it or mixing it with addresses would obscure ownership.
exceptions.src/memory/hardware.inc: Memory-mapped hardware address vocabulary; it emits no bytes and is separated from game RAM.
exceptions.src/memory/ram.inc: Work-RAM ABI declaration; it emits no bytes and remains a single searchable address map.
exceptions.src/data/art.s: Compact ordered asset include ledger whose physical ROM position is the reason for the boundary.
exceptions.src/data/bank0.s: Fixed first-bank bridge containing the Z80 image, jump table, and Japanese font at their ROM positions.
exceptions.src/data/level_layout.s: Dense level-layout data physically interleaved between enemy implementations in the original ROM.
exceptions.src/game/bonus/mode.s: Bonus-round state flow is physically separated from its object implementations by the ROM layout.
exceptions.src/game/enemies/spawner.s: Complete enemy-spawner and score-popup unit; neighbouring ROM code belongs to other actors.
exceptions.src/game/round/select_and_setup.s: Complete pre-round controller; adding the following 440-line state machine would exceed the maximum.
exceptions.src/game/screens/attract_mode.s: Self-contained attract-mode input player stored between the ending and actor implementations.
exceptions.src/game/screens/game_over.s: Fixed text-only game-over tail; merging it with bonus objects or art would cross subsystem boundaries.
exceptions.src/game/text_encoding.s: Compact character lookup and RNG block isolated by the surrounding RLE and interrupt code.
exceptions.src/rendering/rle.s: Self-contained RLE decoder and VRAM-address helper isolated in the original ROM order.
exceptions.src/rendering/text.s: Complete text renderer isolated by the VBlank handler before it and world code after it.
exceptions.src/rendering/tilemap.s: Complete tilemap transfer unit separated from other rendering code by the Z80 host block.
exceptions.src/rendering/vdp.s: Complete VDP hardware layer; the next contiguous ROM block belongs to the sound subsystem.
exceptions.src/sound/engine.s: Small 68000 sound initializer isolated between the Z80 data payload and rendering code.
exceptions.src/sound/z80/driver.asm: Standalone Z80 translation-unit index; implementation lives in its size-bounded included modules.
exceptions.src/sound/z80/driver/abi.asm: Non-emitting Z80 hardware and resident-RAM ABI shared by every driver implementation module.
exceptions.src/sound/z80/host.s: Complete 68000 Z80 bus and command-queue driver occupying its own fixed ROM block.
exceptions.src/sound/z80/load_data.s: ROM load descriptors and payload include kept together so their computed source pointers remain visible.
exceptions.src/system/dma.s: Complete DMA implementation only slightly below the preferred minimum and bounded by compression code.
exceptions.src/system/game_entry.s: Fixed game-entry and mode-dispatch block separated from startup by the first ROM bank.
exceptions.src/system/input.s: Self-contained controller driver physically located between compression and VDP implementations.
exceptions.src/system/vblank.s: Self-contained interrupt handler isolated between text encoding and the text renderer.
